implementation_notes: Model the process as past-tense events on a timeline, one sticky note each, in the business's own words. Commands, actors, policies and aggregates get added afterwards — starting with them produces a data model, not a process.
idiom_name: orange events on a timeline, then blue commands, yellow aggregates
code_sketch:
Kick-off -> Chaotic exploration -> Enforce the timeline
-> People & systems -> Problems & opportunities -> Pick one problem
# Big Picture: whole business line, 15-20 people, unlimited wall
pitfalls: Never following up on the picture
